# VelBiz Digital

> VelBiz Digital, a unit of Velcaryn LLP based in Tirunelveli, Tamil Nadu, India, designs and builds websites for small businesses, takes them live, and runs the SEO, content and social work that brings people to them. It also offers VelBiz Cloud, GST invoicing, accounting and inventory software for small businesses.

## Websites for small businesses

- Three one-time prices, agreed before work starts, with no monthly fee to keep the website switched on: a Starter Business Website at ₹9,999, an Advanced Business Website with a dashboard, inventory, quotes and analytics at ₹17,999, and a Full-Scale E-Commerce Suite that takes payments at ₹24,999.
- Mobile-first and fast, and the business owns the code and the domain.
- Also: local SEO and Google Business Profile setup, and website copywriting and social media content in English and Tamil.
- Serves Tirunelveli, Nagercoil, Thoothukudi, Tenkasi, Madurai, Chennai, Coimbatore and Vellore, and Tamil Nadu more widely.

## VelBiz Cloud (business software)

- One system for the day-to-day of a small business: enquiries and quotes, GST invoices, stock across the shop and the godown, purchases and vendors, double-entry accounts, expenses with approval, and a monthly payroll run.
- GST invoices and quotes are numbered in sequence on the business's own letterhead; tax rates are set per item code, and a GST filing summary is ready at the end of each quarter.
- Every invoice has a link the customer opens in a browser, with no app and no login.
- Runs in the browser on a phone, tablet or computer.
- Data can be exported in open formats at any time, with no lock-in clause and no export fee.
- Getting started: a short signup form; VelBiz sets the workspace up and sends the login.
